_comment: B1-047 D2.5: hand-authored WHEN-to-use phrase per diagram profile. tools/build-ai-reference.mjs fails the build if any profile id in standard/registry/profiles/catalogue.json lacks an entry here, or if an entry names an unknown profile. Keep phrases terse (<= 12 words), author-intent oriented.

annotations.ddn@1: Default free-form graph; any kinds/verbs; use when no stricter profile fits
annotations.flow.basic@1: Simple flowchart: start/end, process, decision branches, one path logic
annotations.flow.documented@2: Flowchart with off-page connectors and annotation notes attached
annotations.dfd.gane_sarson@1: Data-flow diagram (Gane-Sarson): processes, stores, externals, data flows
annotations.dfd.yourdon@1: Data-flow diagram (Yourdon): same model, Yourdon silhouettes
annotations.uml.structure@1: UML class/structure diagram: classes, interfaces, inheritance, associations
annotations.uml.usecase@1: UML use-case diagram: actors, use cases, include/extend (basic)
annotations.uml.usecase@2: UML use-case with subject boundaries and extension-point contracts
annotations.requirements.basic@1: Requirements traceability: requirements, tests, implementations, derives/satisfies/verifies
annotations.chen.basic@1: Chen ER, scalar subset: flat entities, binary association diamonds only
annotations.chen.binary@2: Chen ER extended: weak entities, participation bounds, composite attributes
annotations.matrix.raci@1: RACI responsibility matrix: exactly one A, >=1 R per row
annotations.matrix.crud@1: CRUD matrix: which roles create/read/update/delete which entities
annotations.matrix.relations@1: Generic relationship matrix: any verb as cells between two element sets
annotations.matrix.heatmap@1: Numeric/category encoded matrix: colour-encoded cell values
annotations.matrix.ansoff@1: Ansoff market x product growth quadrant
annotations.matrix.tows@1: TOWS/SWOT strategy quadrant (internal x external factors)
annotations.matrix.storymap@1: User story map: tasks as cells across releases
annotations.panels.basic@1: Free dashboard grid: titled panels with item lists, no fixed panel set
annotations.panels.composed@1: Composed dashboard: panels embedding child views (drill-down, one level)
annotations.panels.journey@1: Customer journey map: phases, actions/touchpoints/opportunities, emotion curve
annotations.panels.pyramid@1: Pyramid/hierarchy bands (3-5 stacked levels, e.g. DIKW, Maslow)
annotations.panels.venn@1: Venn diagram: 2-3 sets with membership-overlap items
annotations.table.records@1: Plain data table: records as rows, bound columns
annotations.chart.radar@1: Radar/spider chart: multivariate comparison across >=3 categories
annotations.chart.funnel@1: Funnel chart: stage conversion with decreasing values
annotations.chart.candlestick@1: Candlestick/OHLC chart for financial time series
annotations.chart.sankey@1: Sankey diagram: flow quantities between categorical nodes
annotations.chart.qq@1: Q-Q plot: compare a sample against a theoretical distribution
annotations.chart.quantiledot@1: Quantile dotplot: distribution as stacked quantile dots
annotations.chart.dotplot@1: Dot plot strip: individual numeric observations along an axis
annotations.chart.boxplot@1: Box plot: five-number summary per category
annotations.chart.violin@1: Violin plot: distribution density per category
annotations.chart.beeswarm@1: Beeswarm: jittered individual points per category
annotations.chart.topk@1: Top-K bar chart: top categories plus an aggregated others bucket
annotations.chart.radialtree@1: Radial tree: hierarchy fanned around a root
annotations.chart.circlepack@1: Circle packing: nested circles for hierarchy
annotations.chart.packedbubble@1: Packed bubbles: flat groups of size-encoded circles
annotations.chart.heatmap@1: Heatmap chart: category x category numeric cells
annotations.chart.densityheatmap@1: 2-D density heatmap of numeric point pairs
annotations.chart.calendar@1: Calendar heatmap: daily values over weeks/months
annotations.chart.wordcloud@1: Word cloud: term weights as sized words
annotations.chart.arc@1: Arc diagram: nodes on a line, relations as arcs
annotations.chart.force@1: Force-directed graph: network layout by simulation
annotations.chart.edgebundle@1: Edge bundling: hierarchical network with bundled edges
annotations.timeline.basic@1: Timeline/Gantt: dated records with start/end and optional dependencies
annotations.fishbone.basic@1: Fishbone/Ishikawa: effect with categorized cause ribs
annotations.decision.rules@1: Decision table (DMN-like): inputs, outputs, x_rule rows, hit policy
annotations.state.flat@1: Flat state machine: one initial, terminals, guarded transitions, trace simulation
annotations.state.composite@1: Hierarchical state machine: composite states and parallel regions
annotations.wbs.tree@1: Work breakdown structure: task decomposition tree
annotations.mindmap.basic@1: Mind map: radial assoc tree around one central topic
annotations.concept.map@1: Concept map: labelled assoc/ref propositions between concepts
annotations.epc.basic@1: EPC process chain: strictly alternating events/functions with and/or/xor connectors
annotations.erd.crowfoot@1: Crow's-foot ERD: tables, fields, cardinality-marked references
annotations.uml.sequence@1: UML sequence diagram: lifelines with ordered messages and returns
annotations.uml.communication@1: UML communication diagram: numbered messages between objects
annotations.uml.object@1: UML object diagram: instances with classifier-bound slots
annotations.uml.activity@1: UML activity diagram: flows with partitions and fork/join bars
annotations.bpmn.basic@1: BPMN collaboration: pools, typed gateways, cross-pool message flows
annotations.uml.timing@1: UML timing diagram: state changes of participants over time
annotations.uml.interaction_overview@1: UML interaction overview: control flow whose nodes reference sub-views
annotations.cmmn.basic@1: CMMN case management: stages, milestones, entry/exit sentries
annotations.sysml.bdd@1: SysML block definition diagram: blocks and their relationships
annotations.sysml.ibd@1: SysML internal block diagram: blocks with ports and flows
annotations.sysml.parametric@1: SysML parametric diagram: constraints each bound to exactly two relations
annotations.pert.cpm@1: PERT/CPM network: estimated tasks, precedence, computed critical path
annotations.fault.tree@1: Fault tree: top event decomposed through and/or gates
annotations.event.tree@1: Event tree: initiating event fanned through and/or gates
annotations.network.basic@1: Network diagram: buses, switches, servers, attachments
annotations.network.rack@1: Rack elevation: equipment placed at unique units inside racks
annotations.wireframe.ui@1: UI wireframe: frames, labels, inputs, buttons, lists
annotations.family.tree@1: Family/genealogy tree: parents, unions, birth/death years
annotations.c4.context@1: C4 system context: people and systems, no interior detail
annotations.c4.container@1: C4 container diagram: one system boundary with containers/stores/queues
annotations.c4.component@1: C4 component diagram: one container boundary with components
annotations.geo.choropleth@1: Choropleth map: regions coloured by a joined numeric value
annotations.geo.symbols@1: Symbol map: sized markers at lon/lat points
annotations.geo.outline@1: Outline map: geography only, no data binding
